summary: First-finish smoke test of Fleet Control app (backend + frontend). All critical backend endpoints and frontend flows work correctly for both admin and user roles.
passed: POST /api/auth/login: admin (aeortega/admin123) returns role=admin; operador returns role=user; invalid credentials return 401
GET /api/auth/me: returns user with valid Bearer token; 401 without token
GET /api/modules/flota returns 78 seeded records; seguros/impuestos/talleres/conductores/multas/mantenimiento all return 200
POST /api/modules/flota with role=user creates record with UUID id (user can create)
PUT /api/modules/flota/{id} with role=user returns 403; DELETE returns 403; DELETE with admin returns 200
GET /api/dashboard returns kpis (all 6 required keys) plus gasto_por_vehiculo, gasto_por_ciudad, multas_por_conductor, consumo_por_vehiculo arrays
GET /api/users: 403 for user, 200 for admin; POST /api/users with duplicate username returns 400
Frontend admin login redirects to dashboard (/) with all 6 KPIs and 4 charts visible
Admin sidebar shows all 8 nav links (Dashboard, Flota, Seguros, Impuestos, Talleres, Conductores, Multas, Mantenimiento, Usuarios)
Admin flota page shows 78 rows with edit + delete buttons on each row; add-button opens flota-form-dialog
User (operador) does not see nav-usuarios link; user does not see edit/delete buttons on flota rows
notes: Dashboard route is '/' not '/dashboard' — the login page redirects to root which renders Dashboard. Edit/delete testids are 'flota-edit-btn' / 'flota-delete-btn' (repeated per row, not suffixed with id). Only Flota module tested in depth on the frontend; other module pages accessible via sidebar but not exhaustively CRUD-tested.
